findings.title: Denial cache is shared across distinct identity types with the same identifier
findings.body: The denial cache key contains only `UserUID`, not `IdentityType`, yet it is consulted before permissions are loaded for users, anonymous identities, and render-service identities. For example, an `anonymous:0` check denied for a dashboard stores the same key subsequently used by `render:0`; the renderer request will then be denied from cache even though `getRendererPermissions` grants renderer read access. Include the identity type in `userPermDenialCacheKey` (and update callers/tests) so a negative result for one subject class cannot poison another class's authorization decisions.
